title: Where do the pinned charts live?

scenes.heading: Where will Argo CD get the chart?
scenes.sub: Decide on registry storage before setup.
voice: The Operator needs a runtime registry for charts, bundles, and validation evidence.
Choose its built-in registry with storage, or provide an external OCI registry you can keep reachable.

scenes.heading: Mirror the chart into that registry
scenes.sub: The plan records the content digest.
voice: The Operator mirrors the chart needed by a plan into the runtime registry.
The plan records the mirrored chart by digest so Argo CD can retrieve those exact bytes.

scenes.heading: Argo CD retrieves the pinned copy
scenes.sub: A missing digest prevents the pull.
voice: Argo CD reads the chart from the runtime registry during deployment.
If the content at the pinned digest is unavailable, the pull fails and the expected release cannot become ready.

scenes.heading: Keep the registry reachable
voice: Existing plans record where their mirrored charts live.
Choose the registry mode before installation, and keep its storage and access in place for the plans the cluster uses.

viewer: Platform engineers setting up the Operator preview
payoff: Follow one chart from the publisher through the runtime registry to a digest-pinned Argo CD pull.
